target_moa.text: Regadenoson is a low-affinity A2A adenosine receptor agonist; activation of the A2A adenosine receptor produces coronary vasodilation and increases coronary blood flow

citations.quote: Regadenoson is an A_{2A} adenosine receptor agonist that is a coronary vasodilator [see *Clinical Pharmacology* (12.1)].
Activation of the A_{2A} adenosine receptor by regadenoson produces coronary vasodilation and increases coronary blood flow (CBF).
Regadenoson is chemically described as adenosine, 2-[4-[(methylamino)carbonyl]-1H-pyrazol-1-yl]-, monohydrate.
